versions.content: Compatibility of ApplicationCompositeElementDat- aPrototype typed by primitive data type of category STRING in a PortPro- totype and a SystemSignal to which the ApplicationCompositeElement- DataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping If a VariableDataPrototype in a PortPrototype typed by ApplicationCompos- iteDataType is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping to a SystemSignalGroup then the following conditions shall be fulfilled by an Appli- cationCompositeElementDataPrototype that is aggregated by the Applica- tionCompositeDataType and the SystemSignal of the SystemSignalGroup to which the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is mapped in case that the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is typed by an Appli- cationPrimitiveDataType of category STRING: • the swTextProps s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationPrimitiveDataType of the ApplicationCompositeElement- DataPrototype are compatible to the swTextProps s of SystemSignal. physicalProps according to [constr_10632] (see [4]).
